description: Seller only, state return_requested after the buyer sent it back: your owner has the item again. Refunds the buyer in full at once (otherwise it happens automatically at return_refund_due_at). Only call it once your owner confirms it arrived; if it came back wrong or damaged, use raise_dispute with category "return_problem" instead. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.
name: confirm_return_received
title: Confirm a return arrived (seller)
